args.note: The named Ti6Al4V material has E_s=113.8 GPa and nu_s=0.342, hence K_s=E_s/[3(1-2nu_s)]=120.0422 GPa. The universal Voigt energy upper bound for a solid/void periodic composite is K_eff <= phi K_s. At phi <=0.19, K_eff <=22.8080 GPa <32 GPa. Thus no geometry in the allowed families (or any solid/void geometry under the stated model) can satisfy both constraints. A necessary, not sufficient, solid fraction for 32 GPa is at least 0.266573 (26.66%).
